name: Curried Cauliflower Quinoa Bowl with Arugula, Pistachios & Mint

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine the spice oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Separate each cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice oil and stir to coat. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower is fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the cauliflower is roasting, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the mint in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Add yogurt, tahini, water, vinegar, additional garlic powder, and salt to the bowl with the mint. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup tahini
¼ cup water
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide quinoa, cauliflower, arugula, and cucumber between bowls. Drizzle with sauce, then top with pistachios and reserved mint. Enjoy!
